давай + 1st person plural or infinitive

examples.text: Давай мы его уволим, а тебя на его место назначим.
examples.trans: Let's fire him and put you in his place.

давно.gloss: for a long time; long ago

meanings.note: with present: Я давно здесь = I've been here a long time
Manner/predicative adverb in '-о', derived from the neuter short form of the corresponding adjective.

examples.trans: You haven't been interested in me for a long time.

examples.text: Вспомнил? Я давно тебя не интересую.
examples.trans: Now you remember? You haven't been interested in me for a long time.

Core Russian prep meaning 'until, before; up to' in everyday speech.

meanings.note: + infinitive; agrees with the subject: должна (f)
Prefix 'до-' marks reaching a boundary or finishing the remainder of an action (stem 'лжен'). Agrees in gender, number, and case with the noun it modifies ('must, should; owe').

examples.text: Жадность, Паша, должна быть умеренная. Комнатной температуры.
examples.trans: Greed, Pasha, should be moderate. Room temperature.

meanings.note: Contrast дома = at home. Core Russian adv meaning '(to) home, homeward' in everyday speech.

examples.text: А ты иди домой и делай уроки.

examples.text: Так, мы идём к слепым. А ты иди домой и делай уроки.
examples.trans: Right, we're going to the blind people. And you go home and do your homework.

meanings.note: Physical combat or brawl. Common feminine noun meaning 'fight, brawl, scuffle' in everyday Russian.

examples.trans: A noisy fight broke out on the street.

examples.text: У тебя же есть ещё. Дай хоть одну.

meanings.note: To bring an activity to an end. Prefix 'за-' marks beginning an action, covering, or stopping by along the way (stem 'канчивать'). Used as an imperfective (ongoing/repeated action) verb meaning 'to finish, to conclude', paired with 'закончить'.

examples.text: Марина, давай заканчивать эту опасную акцию.
examples.trans: Marina, let's end this dangerous protest.
The craftsmen are already finishing the complex repair.

meanings.note: Prefix 'за-' marks beginning an action, covering, or stopping by along the way (stem 'щитить'). Used as an perfective (single completed action) verb meaning 'to protect, to defend', paired with 'защищать'.

examples.trans: He will be able to protect me.

examples.text: Я думаю, что у меня есть мужчина. Он сможет меня защитить.

examples.text: Мы должны защитить эту историческую стену.

meanings.note: about history: историческое наследие = historical heritage

Important in history. Prefix 'ис-' ('out from within') marks extraction or exhaustion (stem 'торический'). Relational adjective formed with the Slavic suffix '-ский' ('pertaining to'). Agrees in gender, number, and case with the noun it modifies ('historical, historic').

examples.trans: This is the historic centre of the town.

examples.text: Я ваш советник по историческому наследию. Забыли?
examples.trans: I'm your adviser on historical heritage. Have you forgotten?

meanings.en: to begin, to start, to break out (intransitive)
meanings.note: Prefix 'на-' marks surface contact, accumulation, or completing a quantity (stem 'чаться'). Reflexive/intransitive verb with the postfix '-ся'/'-сь' (historically from the reflexive pronoun 'себя', oneself). Used as an perfective (single completed action) verb meaning 'to begin, to start, to break out', paired with 'начинаться'.

examples.text: У меня много опасных друзей. А иначе я позвоню ребятам.

Reflexive/intransitive verb with the postfix '-ся'/'-сь' (historically from the reflexive pronoun 'себя', oneself). Used as an perfective (single completed action) verb meaning 'to remain, to be left', paired with 'оставаться'.

examples.text: Я выйду отсюда через две недели. Я решу все ваши проблемы.

Простые люди = ordinary people. Prefix 'про-' indicates movement through, completion, or missing the mark (stem 'стой'). Agrees in gender, number, and case with the noun it modifies ('simple; ordinary').

Prefix 'с-' ('together' or 'down from') marks convergence or completion (stem 'амый'). Agrees in gender, number, and case with the noun it modifies ('the most; the very').

meanings.note: 'сейчас буду' = I'll be right there
Prefix 'с-' ('together' or 'down from') marks convergence or completion (stem 'ейчас').

examples.text: Конечно, помогу. Кто у вас сейчас начальник?
examples.trans: Of course I'll help. Who's your boss now?

meanings.note: Серьёзный человек. Prefix 'с-' ('together' or 'down from') marks convergence or completion (stem 'ерьёзный'). Adjective formed with the common Slavic suffix '-н-' from a noun/verb root. Agrees in gender, number, and case with the noun it modifies ('serious; important, influential').

Серьёзный человек. Prefix 'с-' ('together' or 'down from') marks convergence or completion (stem 'ерьёзный'). Adjective formed with the common Slavic suffix '-н-' from a noun/verb root. Agrees in gender, number, and case with the noun it modifies ('serious; important, influential').

meanings.note: Prefix 'с-' ('together' or 'down from') marks convergence or completion (stem 'коро'). Manner/predicative adverb in '-о', derived from the neuter short form of the corresponding adjective.

examples.trans: Right, no noise. I'll be back soon.

meanings.note: + accusative. Prefix 'с-' ('together' or 'down from') marks convergence or completion (stem 'лушать'). Used as an imperfective (ongoing/repeated action) verb meaning 'to listen', paired with 'послушать'.
the imperative 'слушай' starts a sentence, like 'look, ...'

'Слушаю' = I'm listening. Prefix 'с-' ('together' or 'down from') marks convergence or completion (stem 'лушать'). Used as an imperfective (ongoing/repeated action) verb meaning 'to listen', paired with 'послушать'.

examples.trans: Listen, Samson, I've been thinking. Your boss is such an experienced specialist.

meanings.en: to save, to rescue from danger

examples.trans: Everyone came running to save you — both me and Dad!

meanings.note: Of a room, building or fortress. Prefix 'с-' ('together' or 'down from') marks convergence or completion (stem 'тена'). Common feminine noun meaning 'wall' in everyday Russian.

examples.trans: The picture is on the wall.

examples.text: Не надо врать. Стену монастыря сносят!
examples.trans: Don't lie. They're pulling down the monastery wall!
